notes.title: New Farming Update!
notes.notes:
It ain't much, but it's honest work.
One of the most popular content requests was a farming career, so here it is.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991069/83fe4068676bff1b4876933ef68cacdcde501772.gif

This is update will go live on the 28th of February (2 days time) at approximately 3pm GMT.

This update features over 60 new items related to farming. Including crops, pots, wheelbarrows, farming tools, and so much more.

This career is one of the more interesting ones and works differently from most of the others. The farmer only receives payment when they harvest a crop that you have placed. The crops each have their own characteristics for you to discover. Some take longer to grow but are worth more when harvested, and some do not need watering often.

This career is one of the new starting careers and is quite strong as it allows you to take advantage of the outside area of the suburbs map early on.

The farmer can also can also grow crops inside, for those of you who like the City map. When a crop is placed inside it is instead placed in a pot.

Also included in this update is a cute pet that unlocks if you own Tiny Pasture on Steam. Check out the My Little Life/ Tiny Pasture bundle if you haven't already. Both can be played at the same time.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991069/3bd79fbe3e0028dd6f4b0d9aafd075ffd36d6d9b.gif


Here are the patch notes:

* New career (Farming)
* 60+ new items
* New Hidden secrets
* 2 new achievements
* New item filter for lights
* New item filter for furniture with slots (like shelves and bookcases)
* Fixes for some small & rare bugs
* Updated Chinese language support for previously added items.
* New pet for owners of Tiny Pasture


In other news, we have sold over 37k copies in the first 26 days. Thanks so much for all your support. <3

-Stevie

notes.title: Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
Massive news time!

My Little Life is releasing on January 31st 2025!
[previewyoutube=hJmUgpZmj1E;full][/previewyoutube]

Super excited to share the game with everyone, and to show what I have been cooking up for the past year.

Some answers to questions I have got:
Will the demo save files be usable in the main game?
The demo save files are technically usable in the main game but I highly recommend not to try. A lot of systems have changed as well as progression. For instance if there is a new item in the main game that is unlocked via an early career that was already completed in the demo, then they will become unobtainable.

How much will the game cost?
Hard to answer due to the location base costing that Steam uses, but I have settled on a cost that I think should be affordable for most.

Will the game get updates after release
Almost definitely, I have so many ideas on what I want to add to the game. And the game will of course receive bug fixing patches regardless. 

Where's the demo gone?
I made the decision to remove the demo from Steam as the save files from the demo won't be transferable to the main game, and I didn't want to have people sink many hours into the demo right before the main game comes out. If you really wanted to continue playing the demo that there is a version on itchio still lingering around.

Thanks for all your support! 

I do have one request;
Please share this game to your friends, colleagues, classmates, everyone. The future if the game depends on it. The more people that buy the game, the more updates it will get.

Love you all.
Stevie

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I just wanted to drop in a let everyone know we are still hard at work developing the full game, here's what we have added so far that will be available in the full game.

Including some of the most requested additions:
* Moving items (without having to sell/buy)
* City mode (sits at the side of your screen instead of the bottom as a tall block of flats/apartments.)
* 6 Careers
* 6 Characters (with their own Fulfillment quests)
* Ability to open both tabs at the same time
* Overarching town progression system
* Ability to name the town, and name the characters too.
* Ability to place certain items outside

Here's a quick look at "City mode":

In other news, we reached 27,000 wishlists! Thanks so much for your support. <3

notes.title: Demo update v0.1.14
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
First of all, we reached 18,822 wishlists, thanks so much for your support! 

Please continue sharing the game with your friends and favorite streamers, doing so can be a massive positive impact on the games development. Content creators also love it when recommendations come directly from their community, rather than random devs or publishers.

This patch adds one of the most requested features to the game - item filtering. You can now select the need or skill you are looking for to see only the items that affect that stat. You can also right click the filter button to reset it quickly.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991069/effb18cbaaa8eb1586024bdf012c7d9c2ae40e7d.gif

Added item filtering
Recoloured the Painting and Streaming skills to make it a little clearer that they are career stats and thus gained differently.



Also remember we are running a home design competition in the discord where you can win the ability to name an upcoming character! More info on that here.

Thanks so much for your amazing support and feedback! <3

notes.title: Demo update v0.1.12
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
The respond from the demo has been amazing, and I'm so happy that you are enjoying it.

I'm listening to all the feedback and have started fixing some of the bugs as well as planning some future changes to improve the demo - and the full game.

In this update:

Fixed crash that occurs when deleting an item that is currently being placed.
Fixed an issue when items no longer exist when the character is carrying a box.
Fixed an issue where a character would get stuck in the carrying animation.
Fixed paint pots incorrectly stating that they need to be placed on the floor.
Fixed bird sound not reducing with volume settings.
Fixed long skinny desk not having prop placement slots.
Characters no longer say HELP.
Long sofa now is intractable and provides comfort.
Increased credit cost of long sofa.
Ensured autosave is on by default.
Increased FP cost of long sofa.
Added washing machine. (This by far the most requested item, weirdly.)


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991069/ea0caf74e5aa4833d67020a2abe510317f237a65.gif

Some potential future plans for the demo according to your feedback:

Ability to filter items by needs and stats.
Restructure of how FP is gained.
Windows?
Horizontal window offset for sidebar users (crazy people)
Ability to choose a corner when in square/camera mode.
Moving items without having to sell/replace them.
Stats only increasing for unique items placed.


The above list will change and be expanded and doesn't include smaller bugs that will also be addressed. It's just a hint as to what's to come.

Thanks so much for your amazing support and feedback so far!
